vherathi_pilot.name: The Vherathi Concord (pilot)
vherathi_pilot.description: Preview-story copy of the pilot culture, just enough for color resolution.

drossholt.name: The Drossholt Company
drossholt.description: A frontier trading and salvage outfit. Blunt riveted plate, bolted seams, even mirrored symmetry - the deliberate opposite of Vherathi asymmetry.

standard_issue.name: The Sol Federation
standard_issue.description: The civil authority that runs the neutral stations. Prefab, painted, interchangeable modules - rounded fillets, a white centerline stripe, amber hazard chevrons.

kaethar_directorate.name: The Kaethar Directorate
kaethar_directorate.description: A cold, hierarchical military power that garrisons the lanes. Hard angles, gunmetal, one warning colour and nothing else - from the warships down to the mess-hall bench.
kaethar_directorate.theme: Kaethar hulls and buildings are stern angular masses - a hard arrowhead or flat gunmetal wall with recessed panel seams, never a curve. Red chevron trim marks every doorway, hatch, and hardpoint - the culture's one warning colour and nothing else. Windows and lights run in strict rows, mirrored pairs, no asymmetry.
kaethar_directorate.naming: PLACES: a system is a garrison designation, the star a bare number. Assets are a function plus a rank word - 'Redoubt', 'Muster Spine', 'Watch Post'. PEOPLE: rank plus surname (Gate Warden, Line Officer). Ships are a duty plus a hard noun (Picket, Bastion, Spearhead).

deeprock_consortium.name: The Deeprock Mining Consortium
deeprock_consortium.description: A working consortium of belt crews and ore haulers. Hardware built around the job it does, painted only where a warning is needed.
deeprock_consortium.theme: Deeprock hardware is front-heavy and functional - a toothed crusher jaw, riveted tank segments, a rung conveyor ridge, an asymmetric ore chute. Hazard yellow only at what needs a warning (vents, chute edges, dock claws) - everything else stays plain riveted metal.
deeprock_consortium.naming: PLACES: a claim number plus what was found there. Assets are the job itself - 'Mine Headframe', 'Processing Shed', 'Mine Camp'. PEOPLE: a role plus surname (Pit Foreman, Belt Crew). Ships are named for the job (Scout, Carrier, Gnaw).
